card.name: Just before 'ang' in angiopathy, angiotensin
card.fires_on: The last piece of a word or hyphen right before a following 'ang-' word start, such as 'amyloid' before 'angiopathy' or 'renin' before '-angiotensin'. It also fires inside 'rearrangement' and 'boomerangs'.

modes.label: Amyloid angiopathy
modes.description: The word 'amyloid' split so that its last piece comes just before 'angiopathy'.

modes.label: Renin-angiotensin
modes.description: The end of 'renin' or the hyphen after it, right before 'angiotensin' in renin-angiotensin system.

modes.label: Other ang- words
modes.description: Pieces just before 'ang' in words like rearrangement or boomerangs.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward 'angle' and 'angular' words, which fits an upcoming 'ang-' word start.
card.plain: It lights up on the text just before a word beginning with 'ang', like angiopathy or angiotensin.
